item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"piece_id":"02","ready":false,"issues":["Bundled Backflip mass checks: 02-c1 combines two exercises under one claim; split them into separate claims.","Unsupported Backflip method detail: 02-c1’s locators do not support the stated STEP import, 1060-aluminum assignment, or two-exercise scope.","Bundled Backflip failures: 02-c2 combines partial add-in reconstruction and the seven-body shelf result; split them.","Overstated add-in reliability: the reported tests show specific discrepancies, not general unreliability.","Bundled Cableteque workflow: 02-c3 combines BOM extraction, compatibility flags, and estimator review; separate the reported product claims.","Missing locator support: 02-c3 does not cite the stated estimator-exception review.","Irrelevant inference evidence: 02-c4 uses the MIT survey’s runnable-code count to support a claim about Cableteque error rates; it does not establish that relationship.","Unsupported absence claim: 02-c4 says Cableteque supplies no accuracy rate without evidence that directly documents the omitted evaluation; state this as a limitation or cite a disclosed evaluation scope.","Mismatched inference evidence: 02-c6 attaches an unrelated podcast result to NVIDIA’s simulation workflow without a precise cross-source relationship."]}
